_readme: Seat/subscription pricing for the vendors and coding tools in data/models.json. Refreshed manually — see scripts/refresh-plans.md. Every price is read verbatim from the vendor's own pricing page HTML fetched with curl; a null price means the page didn't render that number in static HTML (often a JS-driven toggle) or the plan is contact-sales-only — never a guess. Validated by scripts/validate-data.mjs.
